title: Ronaldo Hears “Officer Down” and Thinks Nobody Cares About Him
caption: Ronaldo hears “officer down” and somehow thinks nobody cares about him. Then the phone rings. #StableRonaldo #GTA6 #GTAVI #Gaming
pin: Would you stick around after hearing “officer down,” or would you already be gone?
why: The officer-down call triggers immediate disbelief, then Ronaldo jokes that nobody even cares about him.
